## General

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > General] 1.1 This practice direction provides for a scheme in which, in the circumstances set out in this practice direction, a request for a claim form to be issued and other specified documents may be filed electronically (‘Money Claim Online’).

## 1.2 This practice direction enables claimants –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.2 This practice direction enables claimants –] (1) to start certain types of County Court claims by requesting the issue of a claim form electronically via HM Courts and Tribunals Service website; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.2 This practice direction enables claimants –] (2) where a claim has been started electronically –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.2 This practice direction enables claimants –] (a) to file electronically a request for –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.2 This practice direction enables claimants –] (i) judgment in default;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.2 This practice direction enables claimants –] (ii) judgment on acceptance of an admission of the whole of the amount claimed; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.2 This practice direction enables claimants –] (iii) the issue of a warrant of control; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.2 This practice direction enables claimants –] (b) to view an electronic record of the progress of the claim.

## 1.3 This practice direction also enables defendants–

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.3 This practice direction also enables defendants–] (1) to file electronically–

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.3 This practice direction also enables defendants–] (a) an acknowledgment of service;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.3 This practice direction also enables defendants–] (b) a part admission;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.3 This practice direction also enables defendants–] (c) a defence; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.3 This practice direction also enables defendants–] (d) a counterclaim (if filed together with a defence); and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.3 This practice direction also enables defendants–] (2) to view an electronic record of the progress of the claim.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 1.3 This practice direction also enables defendants–] 1.4 Claims started using Money Claim Online will be issued in the Civil National Business Centre and will proceed at that Centre unless they are sent to a County Court hearing centre. The address for filing any document, application or request (other than one which is filed electronically in accordance with this practice direction) is the Civil National Business Centre, St Katharine’s House, 21-27 St Katharine’s Street, Northampton, NN1 2LH, DX 702885 Northampton 7.

## Security

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Security] 2 HM Courts and Tribunals Service will take such measures as it thinks fit to ensure the security of steps taken or information stored electronically. These may include requiring users of Money Claim Online–

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Security] (1) to enter a customer identification and password;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Security] (2) to provide personal information for identification purposes; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Security] (3) to comply with any other security measures,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Security] before taking any of the steps mentioned in paragraph 1.2 or 1.3.

## Fees

## 3.1 Where this practice direction provides for a fee to be paid electronically, it may be paid by –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 3.1 Where this practice direction provides for a fee to be paid electronically, it may be paid by –] (1) credit card;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 3.1 Where this practice direction provides for a fee to be paid electronically, it may be paid by –] (2) debit card; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 3.1 Where this practice direction provides for a fee to be paid electronically, it may be paid by –] (3) any other method which HM Courts and Tribunals Service may permit.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 3.1 Where this practice direction provides for a fee to be paid electronically, it may be paid by –] 3.2 A step may only be taken using Money Claim Online on payment of the prescribed fee. The Civil Proceedings Fees Order 2008 provides that a party may, in certain circumstances, be entitled to a remission or part remission of a fee prescribed by that Order. HM Courts and Tribunals Service website contains guidance as to when this entitlement might arise.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 3.1 Where this practice direction provides for a fee to be paid electronically, it may be paid by –] 3.3 A claimant who wishes to apply for a remission or part remission of fees must not use Money Claim Online and must file the claim form at the County Court Money Claims Centre.

## Types of claims which may be started using Money Claim Online

## 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (1) the only remedy claimed is a specified amount of money –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (a) less than £100,000 (excluding any interest or costs claimed); and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (b) in sterling;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (2) the procedure under Part 7 is used;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (3) the claimant is not –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (a) a child or protected party; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (b) in receipt of legal aid,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (3A) the claimant’s address for service is within the United Kingdom;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (4) the claim is against –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (a) a single defendant; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (b) two defendants, if the claim is for a single amount against each of them;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (5) the defendant is not –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (a) the Crown; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (b) a person known to be a child or protected party; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (6) the defendant’s address for service is within England and Wales.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 4 A claim may be started using Money Claim Online if it meets all the following conditions –] (‘Protected party’ has the same meaning as in rule 21.1(2).)

## Starting a claim

## 5.1 A claimant may request the issue of a claim form by–

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.1 A claimant may request the issue of a claim form by–] (1) completing and sending an online claim form; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.1 A claimant may request the issue of a claim form by–] (2) electronically paying the appropriate issue fee,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.1 A claimant may request the issue of a claim form by–] via HM Courts and Tribunals Service website.

## 5.2 Detailed particulars of claim must either be –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.2 Detailed particulars of claim must either be –] (1) included in the online claim form but must be limited in size to not more than 1080 characters (including spaces); or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.2 Detailed particulars of claim must either be –] (2) served and filed by the claimant separately from the claim form in accordance with paragraph 6 but the claimant must –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.2 Detailed particulars of claim must either be –] (a) state that detailed particulars of claim will follow; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.2 Detailed particulars of claim must either be –] (b) include a brief summary of the claim,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.2 Detailed particulars of claim must either be –] in the online claim form in the section headed ‘particulars of claim’.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.2 Detailed particulars of claim must either be –] 5.2A The requirement in paragraph 7.3 of Practice Direction 16 for documents to be attached to the particulars of contract claims does not apply to claims started using an online claim form, unless the particulars of claim are served separately in accordance with paragraph 5.2 of this practice direction.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.2 Detailed particulars of claim must either be –] 5.3 When an online claim form is received by the Money Claim Online website, an acknowledgment of receipt will automatically be sent to the claimant. The acknowledgment of receipt does not constitute a notice that the claim form has been issued.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.2 Detailed particulars of claim must either be –] 5.4 When the court issues a claim form following the submission of an online claim form, the claim is ‘brought’ for the purposes of the Limitation Act 1980 and any other enactment on the date on which the online claim form is received by the court’s computer system. The court will keep a record, by electronic or other means, of when online claim forms are received.

## 5.5 When the court issues a claim form, it will –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.5 When the court issues a claim form, it will –] (1) serve a printed version of the claim form on the defendant; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.5 When the court issues a claim form, it will –] (2) send the claimant notice of issue.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.5 When the court issues a claim form, it will –] 5.6 The claim form will have printed on it a unique customer identification number or a password by which the defendant may access details of the claim on HM Courts and Tribunals Service website.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 5.5 When the court issues a claim form, it will –] 5.7 The claim form will be deemed to be served on the fifth day after the claim was issued irrespective of whether that day is a business day or not. ‘Business day’ has the same meaning as in rule 6.2(b).

## Particulars of claim and certificate of service

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Particulars of claim and certificate of service] 6.1 Where the particulars of claim are served by the claimant separately from the claim form pursuant to paragraph 5.2(2), the claimant must –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Particulars of claim and certificate of service] (1) serve the particulars of claim in accordance with rule 7.4(1)(b); and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Particulars of claim and certificate of service] (2) file a certificate of service in form N215 at the Civil National Business Centre within 14 days of service of the particulars of claim on the defendant.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Particulars of claim and certificate of service] 6.2 The certificate of service may be filed by sending form N215 by email to ccbc@justice.gov.uk . However, the subject line to the e-mail must contain the claim number.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Particulars of claim and certificate of service] 6.3 The claimant must file the particulars of claim at the court to which the proceedings are sent under paragraph 12.1 or 12.2 within 7 days of service of the notice of transfer by the court.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Particulars of claim and certificate of service] 6.4 Where the proceedings are not sent to a County Court hearing centre under paragraph 12.1 or 12.2 and remain at the Civil National Business Centre, the claimant is not required to file the particulars of claim unless ordered to do so.

## Online response

## 7.1 A defendant wishing to file –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 7.1 A defendant wishing to file –] (1) an acknowledgment of service of the claim form under Part 10;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 7.1 A defendant wishing to file –] (2) a part admission under rule 14.2;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 7.1 A defendant wishing to file –] (3) a defence under Part 15; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 7.1 A defendant wishing to file –] (4) a counterclaim (to be filed together with a defence),

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 7.1 A defendant wishing to file –] may, instead of filing a written form, do so by completing and sending the relevant online form at www.hmcourts-service.gov.uk/onlineservices/mcol.

## 7.2 Where a defendant files an online form –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 7.2 Where a defendant files an online form –] (1) a hard copy must not be sent in addition;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 7.2 Where a defendant files an online form –] (2) the form is not filed until it is received by the court, whatever time it is shown to have been sent;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 7.2 Where a defendant files an online form –] (3) an online form received after 4 p.m. will be treated as filed on the next day the court office is open; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 7.2 Where a defendant files an online form –] (4) where a time limit applies, it remains the responsibility of the defendant to ensure that the online form is filed in time.

## Counterclaim

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Counterclaim] 8 Where a counterclaim is filed using an online form, any fee payable must be paid to the court to which the claim is transferred under paragraph 12.1 or 12.2.

## Statement of truth

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Statement of truth] 9.1 Part 22 requires any statement of case to be verified by a statement of truth. This applies to all online forms.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Statement of truth] 9.2 The statement of truth in an online statement of case must be in the form specified in paragraph 2.1 of Practice Direction 22.

## 9.3 Attention is drawn to –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 9.3 Attention is drawn to –] (1) paragraph 3 of Practice Direction 22, which provides who may sign a statement of truth; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 9.3 Attention is drawn to –] (2) rule 32.14, which sets out the consequences of making, or causing to be made, a false statement in a document verified by a statement of truth, without an honest belief in its truth.

## Signature

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Signature] 10 Any provision of the CPR which requires a document to be signed by any person is satisfied by that person entering their name on an online form.

## Request for judgment or issue of warrant

## 11.1 If, in a claim started using Money Claim Online–

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.1 If, in a claim started using Money Claim Online–] (1) the claimant wishes to apply for judgment in default in accordance with Part 12; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.1 If, in a claim started using Money Claim Online–] (2) the defendant has made an admission of the whole of the claim in accordance with rule 14.2,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.1 If, in a claim started using Money Claim Online–] the claimant may request judgment to be entered in default or on the admission (as the case may be) by completing and sending an online request form at www.hmcourts-service.gov.uk/onlineservices/mcol.

## 11.2 Where –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.2 Where –] (1) judgment has been entered following a request under paragraph 11.1; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.2 Where –] (2) the claimant is entitled to the issue of a warrant of control without requiring the permission of the court,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.2 Where –] the claimant may request the issue of a warrant of control by –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.2 Where –] (a) completing and sending an online request form; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.2 Where –] (b) electronically paying the appropriate fee,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.2 Where –] at www.hmcourts-service.gov.uk/onlineservices/mcol.

## 11.3 A request under paragraph 11.1 or 11.2 will be treated as being filed –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.3 A request under paragraph 11.1 or 11.2 will be treated as being filed –] (1) on the day the court receives the request, if it receives it before 9a.m. on a working day (which is any day on which the court is open); and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 11.3 A request under paragraph 11.1 or 11.2 will be treated as being filed –] (2) otherwise, on the next working day after the court receives the request.

## Transfer of claim

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Transfer of claim] 12.1 Where the defendant is an individual and the claim has not been sent to a County Court hearing centre, the claim will be sent to the defendant’s home court –

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Transfer of claim] (1) under rule 13.4, if the defendant applies to set aside or vary judgment; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Transfer of claim] (2) under rule 14.12, if there is to be a hearing for a judge to determine the time and rate of payment;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Transfer of claim] (3) under rule 26.2, if a defence is filed to all or part of the claim; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Transfer of claim] (4) if either party makes an application which cannot be dealt with without a hearing.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Transfer of claim] 12.2 Where the defendant is not an individual, and one of the events mentioned in paragraph 12.1 arises, the claim will be sent to the County Court hearing centre which serves the claimant’s address for service which is stated on the claim form.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Transfer of claim] 12.3 If a defence is filed to all or part of the claim and the parties have filed their directions questionnaires, the proceedings will be sent in accordance with rule 26.3(3) to (7).

## Enforcement

## 12A.1 An application for—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 12A.1 An application for—] (a) an order for a judgment debtor to attend court for questioning pursuant to an order for information under CPR Part 71;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 12A.1 An application for—] (b) a third party debt order under Par (c) a charging order under Part 73;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 12A.1 An application for—] must be issued in accordance with paragraphs 9.1 and 11.1 of section 2 of Practice Direction 70, unless the proceedings have already been sent to a County Court hearing centre.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > 12A.1 An application for—] 12A.2 A request for a warrant of control to enforce a judgment or order made at the Centre must be made to the Centre, unless the proceedings have since been sent to a County Court hearing centre.

## Viewing the case record

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Viewing the case record] 13.1 A facility will be provided for parties or their legal representatives to view an electronic record of the status of claims started using Money Claim Online.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 7C – MONEY CLAIM ONLINE > Viewing the case record] 13.2 The record of each claim will be reviewed and, if necessary, updated at least once each day until the claim is sent from the Civil National Business Centre.
